lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit, with approximately 5-7 visible nodes per column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroid blobs, forming a repetitive grid pattern where the blobs act as vertices within the faint vertical stripe framework.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible; the most prominent medial ridge exhibits a high-contrast transition from high-intensity white pixels on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras), including one individual attached to the lateral flank above the pectoral fin and five individuals trailing in the ventral water column.
